page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores using Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this server type.

The hardware profile presents a clear tradeoff between storage capacity and storage speed, as the massive storage pool relies on traditional HDD technology rather than solid-state drives. This makes the instance highly cost-efficient for cold data storage, large-scale data archiving, and sequential-access workloads where capacity density is prioritized over random input/output operations per second. Appropriate workloads include distributed file systems, big data processing pipelines, data warehousing, and large-scale backup repositories.
